summary: Mercedes-Benz Auto Lease Trust 2026-B filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement tied to its issuance of $1,002,400,000 principal amount of asset-backed notes under an October 14, 2026 prospectus. The depositor, Mercedes-Benz Trust Leasing LLC, and sponsor MBFS USA entered an underwriting agreement with Credit Agricole, SMBC Nikko and TD Securities as representatives. Related indentures and trust agreements were filed, plus Form SF-3 CEO certifications. This is a routine auto-lease ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; no deal terms apply. Watch only for standard ABS performance and credit metrics.
